questions.q: Why should a serving application load models:/cancel-risk-model@champion instead of a hard-coded version number?
options: Version numbers are not allowed in model URIs
Aliases load faster than versions
Promotion and rollback become one-line alias changes with no code edit
The alias makes the model more accurate
questions.explain: The alias is a movable pointer. Moving it from version 1 to 2 (and back) changes what is served without touching the serving code.

questions.q: In our registry, version 2 was the most recently registered. Why is that not a reason to serve it?
options: Latest only means most recently registered, not best or approved
The registry hides the latest version from serving code
Newer versions are always less accurate
Version 2 had no run attached
questions.explain: Version 2 tied version 1 at 0.744 test ROC AUC and its validation_status was still pending. Serve what has been validated and aliased.

questions.q: What did MLflow 2.14.3 do when we called transition_model_version_stage?
options: It raised an error and refused
It worked but warned that stages are deprecated since 2.9.0 and will be removed in a future major release
It silently created an alias instead
It deleted the model version
questions.explain: Stages such as Staging and Production still functioned but produced a FutureWarning. New work should use aliases and tags.

questions.q: We deleted version 1 while the champion alias pointed at it. What happened next?
options: MLflow blocked the delete because the alias was in use
The alias automatically moved to version 2
The alias was removed and loading @champion failed with 'alias not found'
Version 1 was archived and still loadable
questions.explain: On our local file store the delete succeeded and took the alias with it. Move the alias first, tag the old version deprecated, and delete only when nothing references it.

questions.q: Which set of steps retires an old version safely?
options: Delete it, then create a new alias
Transition it to Archived and delete the experiment
Rename the registered model
Move the alias to the serving version, tag the old one deprecated, delete only when unreferenced
questions.explain: Keeping the tagged version preserves history and rollback options, and moving the alias first means serving never loses its target.
